# InnovaConsult.ai

> AI consulting and LLM integration for businesses. Part of Innova Consulting Group with 12+ years of experience across 300+ jurisdictions.

## About

InnovaConsult.ai is the AI division of Innova Consulting Group. We help companies implement artificial intelligence solutions that deliver measurable ROI — from strategy and roadmap to production deployment and optimization.

## Services

- **AI Strategy & Roadmap**: Business process assessment, AI opportunity identification, phased implementation roadmaps with KPIs and ROI projections.
- **LLM Integration (ChatGPT/Claude API)**: Production-grade large language model integration, API orchestration, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and cost optimization.
- **Process Automation with AI Agents**: Autonomous AI agents for complex multi-step workflows including data extraction, analysis, decision-making, and reporting.
- **Custom AI Chatbots & Assistants**: Domain-specific conversational AI for customer support, internal tools, and lead qualification, trained on your knowledge base.
- **Crypto & FinTech AI Solutions**: AI-powered compliance monitoring, transaction analysis, risk scoring, and automated reporting for cryptocurrency and financial technology companies.
- **AI-Powered SEO & Content (LLM Optimization / GEO)**: Generative Engine Optimization, automated content pipelines, semantic SEO, and structured data strategies.
